claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemLastChargeOutcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current last-charge lifecycle only models destruction. Staff of Power needs a branched last-charge outcome that can partially suppress item properties or restore charges instead.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.resource_spent_multiplier
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current linked resource amount is only 1:1 with charges spent. Retributive Strike requires damage scaled by fixed multipliers of the staff's charge count.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff ... a creature takes Force damage equal to 4 times the number of charges in the staff

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ActivationChargeSpend.all_remaining_and_destroy
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Non-spell charge-pool activations need a way to consume the remaining pool and destroy the item as part of that activation, rather than only via depletion lifecycle policies.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Magic action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface. The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion
